statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-116326 (PostgreSQL plperl tied-object exceptions follow stale sigjmp_buf): a tied Perl object, or one whose overloaded conversion throws while plperl is handling another error, makes plperl use a stale sigjmp_buf; PostgreSQL has not ruled out arbitrary code execution. It is fixed upstream in PostgreSQL 16.16 for the 16 major version. The PostgreSQL security page, https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116326/, lists 16.16 as the fixed release for 16, and the 16.16 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/16.16/, list this CVE. The fix on the REL_16_STABLE branch is three commits that carry the trailer "Security: CVE-2026-116326" and are in the REL_16_16 tag: https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/26a89a81ad2006bcc3da41359f244cdcab06ce8a (support tied Perl objects in plperl and its contrib modules), https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/ab70d013ea5600d5db49b6cd9d8e6ee475b48769 (cope with errors thrown from tied structures) and https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/8d6ca43589a3b724b0669f830783a0718a696bb4 (further hardening against tied scalars). plperl.so, shipped in postgresql16-plperl in every build, contains the "unexpected Perl longjmp" error message that the second commit adds in 16.16-r0 on both architectures and lacks it in every earlier build. Alpine's postgresql16 16.16-r0 on the 3.23-stable branch upgrades to the upstream 16.16 release and lists CVE-2026-116326 under 16.16-r0 in its secfixes: https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/859fa0795e895af033fab32094a83301f2b4d8ff/community/postgresql16/APKBUILD. Of the Alpine patches applied in that APKBUILD, only perl-rpath.patch touches a file the fix also changes: it adds an rpath link flag to src/pl/plperl/GNUmakefile, where the first commit only adds a regression test to the test list. No Alpine patch changes the C sources or headers the fix changes. This owner covers the packages built from Alpine's postgresql16 recipe: postgresql16 and its subpackages postgresql16-client, -contrib, -contrib-jit, -dev, -doc, -jit, -openrc, -plperl, -plperl-contrib, -plpython3, -plpython3-contrib and -pltcl. We checked every package built from that source in the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository, 4 builds (16.13-r0, 16.14-r0, 16.15-r0 and 16.16-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, each against its index checksum; 16.14-r0 for x86_64 is published without the -plperl-contrib, -plpython3, -plpython3-contrib and -pltcl subpackages. The server binary /usr/libexec/postgresql16/postgres in each build reports its release on both architectures: PostgreSQL 16.13 in 16.13-r0, PostgreSQL 16.14 in 16.14-r0, PostgreSQL 16.15 in 16.15-r0 and PostgreSQL 16.16 in 16.16-r0. The builds before 16.16-r0 (16.13-r0, 16.14-r0 and 16.15-r0) are PostgreSQL releases before 16.16 and are affected; 16.16-r0 carries the fix.

CVE-2026-116326 (PostgreSQL plperl tied-object exceptions follow stale sigjmp_buf): a tied Perl object, or a Perl object whose overloaded conversion throws while plperl is handling another error, makes plperl use a stale sigjmp_buf; PostgreSQL has not ruled out arbitrary code execution. It is fixed upstream in PostgreSQL 17.12 for major version 17. The PostgreSQL security page, https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116326/, lists 17.12 as the fixed release for 17, and the 17.12 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/17.12/, list this CVE. The fix on the REL_17_STABLE branch is three commits that carry the trailer "Security: CVE-2026-116326" and are contained in the REL_17_12 tag and not in REL_17_11: https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/217eb08b45c5e90d3f084a4de42590da229541a3 (support tied Perl objects in plperl and the hstore_plperl and jsonb_plperl transforms), https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/62a19e1588d617dd03137525e94b63b1edd9c64f (cope with errors thrown from tied structures, which also changes the server's error-handling code in src/backend/utils/error/elog.c) and https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/6e5524cdad1064d660a9d349649dcb4f6c9d3cc4 (further hardening against tied scalars). Alpine's postgresql17 17.12-r0 on the 3.23-stable branch upgrades to the upstream 17.12 release and lists CVE-2026-116326 under 17.12-r0 in its secfixes: https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/ce22298320177ae25085d86fbf3b4fc1150c16a2/main/postgresql17/APKBUILD. Of the Alpine patches applied in that APKBUILD, only perl-rpath.patch touches a file the fix also changes: it adds an rpath link flag to src/pl/plperl/GNUmakefile, where the first commit only adds a regression test to the test list. No Alpine patch changes the C sources or headers the fix changes. The DHI postgresql17 17.12-r0 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from that APKBUILD and the upstream PostgreSQL 17.12 source tarball. The DHI Alpine 3.23 package repository (x86_64 and aarch64) publishes packages built from source postgresql17 at 17.7-r0, 17.8-r0, 17.9-r0, 17.10-r0, 17.11-r0 and 17.12-r0; we downloaded the packages named below for every one of those builds on both architectures, each checked against its index checksum. The plperl code is in usr/lib/postgresql17/plperl.so, which the postgresql17-plperl subpackage ships in every published build on both architectures, and the hstore_plperl transform, usr/lib/postgresql17/hstore_plperl.so, is shipped by postgresql17-plperl-contrib in every published build on both architectures. In the 17.12-r0 build the postgres server binary, usr/libexec/postgresql17/postgres, reports PostgreSQL 17.12 on both x86_64 and aarch64, and in each earlier build (17.7-r0, 17.8-r0, 17.9-r0, 17.10-r0 and 17.11-r0) it reports that older 17.x release on both architectures. plperl.so contains the "unexpected Perl longjmp" error message that the second commit adds in 17.12-r0 on both architectures and lacks it in every earlier build. The earlier builds are upstream releases before 17.12, so they are affected; 17.12-r0 and later carry the fix.

CVE-2026-116326 (PostgreSQL plperl tied-object exceptions follow stale sigjmp_buf) is fixed upstream in PostgreSQL 18.7 for major version 18. The PostgreSQL security page, https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116326/, lists 18.7 as the fixed release for 18, the 18.7 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/18.7/, list this CVE, and the CVE record, https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-116326, lists 18 as affected before 18.7. The fix on the REL_18_STABLE branch is three commits, each carrying the trailer "Security: CVE-2026-116326", contained in the REL_18_7 tag and not in REL_18_6: https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/bbe476c747f31e521dbdc395fc6f16db96fc680d makes PL/Perl and the hstore_plperl and jsonb_plperl transforms read tied Perl values correctly; https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/8d308caee3a53aae1ebcb2cb64f72cce108239c1 makes PL/Perl keep Perl's and PostgreSQL's error-recovery jump stacks in step, so that an error thrown from a tied array, hash or scalar no longer jumps to a stale sigjmp_buf, and changes src/pl/plperl/plperl.c and plperl.h, src/backend/utils/error/elog.c, src/include/utils/elog.h and src/include/c.h; and https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/3ce3d94c0da1a9ad512b743f85228e69883940ec stops PL/Perl from running user overload code when it tests or stringifies a thrown Perl error, in src/pl/plperl/plperl.c and plperl.h. Alpine's postgresql18 18.7-r0 on the 3.23-stable branch upgrades to the upstream 18.7 release and lists CVE-2026-116326 under 18.7-r0 in its secfixes: https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/59a1f1d230675807d5a95a0c1e57ba5d640ba039/main/postgresql18/APKBUILD. The only Alpine patch that touches a file the fix changes is perl-rpath.patch, which adds an rpath link flag to src/pl/plperl/GNUmakefile; the fix changes that file only to add the plperl_tied regression test. The DHI postgresql18 18.7-r0 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from that APKBUILD and the upstream PostgreSQL 18.7 source tarball. The DHI Alpine 3.23 package repository (main and security, x86_64 and aarch64) publishes packages built from source postgresql18 at 18.1-r0, 18.2-r0, 18.3-r0, 18.4-r0, 18.6-r0 and 18.7-r0. The vulnerable code is in PL/Perl, usr/lib/postgresql18/plperl.so, which the postgresql18-plperl subpackage ships in every published build on both architectures. In the 18.7-r0 build the postgres server binary reports PostgreSQL 18.7 on both x86_64 and aarch64, and in each earlier build (18.1-r0, 18.2-r0, 18.3-r0, 18.4-r0 and 18.6-r0) it reports that older 18.x release on both architectures. The plperl.so in the 18.7-r0 build contains the "unexpected Perl longjmp, code %d" message that commit 8d308ca adds and the "Perl error could not be converted to a string" message that commit 3ce3d94 adds, on both architectures, and the plperl.so in every earlier build contains neither. The earlier builds are upstream releases before 18.7, so they are affected; 18.7-r0 and later carry the fix.

CVE-2026-116326 (PostgreSQL plperl tied-object exceptions follow stale sigjmp_buf) is fixed upstream in PostgreSQL 18.7 for major version 18. The PostgreSQL security page, https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116326/, lists 18.7 as the fixed release for 18, the 18.7 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/18.7/, list this CVE, and the CVE record, https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-116326, lists 18 as affected before 18.7. The fix on the REL_18_STABLE branch is three commits, each carrying the trailer "Security: CVE-2026-116326", contained in the REL_18_7 tag and not in REL_18_6: https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/bbe476c747f31e521dbdc395fc6f16db96fc680d makes PL/Perl and the hstore_plperl and jsonb_plperl transforms read tied Perl values correctly; https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/8d308caee3a53aae1ebcb2cb64f72cce108239c1 makes PL/Perl keep Perl's and PostgreSQL's error-recovery jump stacks in step, so that an error thrown from a tied array, hash or scalar no longer jumps to a stale sigjmp_buf, and changes src/pl/plperl/plperl.c and plperl.h, src/backend/utils/error/elog.c, src/include/utils/elog.h and src/include/c.h; and https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/3ce3d94c0da1a9ad512b743f85228e69883940ec stops PL/Perl from running user overload code when it tests or stringifies a thrown Perl error, in src/pl/plperl/plperl.c and plperl.h. Alpine's postgresql18 18.7-r0 on the 3.23-stable branch upgrades to the upstream 18.7 release and lists CVE-2026-116326 under 18.7-r0 in its secfixes: https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/59a1f1d230675807d5a95a0c1e57ba5d640ba039/main/postgresql18/APKBUILD. The only Alpine patch that touches a file the fix changes is perl-rpath.patch, which adds an rpath link flag to src/pl/plperl/GNUmakefile; the fix changes that file only to add the plperl_tied regression test. PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-116326 (plperl uses a stale sigjmp_buf when a tied Perl object, or one whose overloaded conversion throws, raises an exception while plperl handles another error) in 17.12 on the 17 branch: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116326/. Checked every published build of this owner on amd64 and arm64: the server binary in 17.12-0 and in the build of Debian's 17.12-0+deb13u1 reports PostgreSQL 17.12, which contains the fix; the earlier builds, 17.11-1 and the build of Debian's 17.11-0+deb13u1, report PostgreSQL 17.11. plperl is shipped in the postgresql-plperl-17 package of the builds of Debian's 17.11-0+deb13u1 and 17.12-0+deb13u1; the 17.11-1 and 17.12-0 packages do not include plperl, so 17.11-1 reads as affected by its version only, and the build of Debian's 17.11-0+deb13u1 is affected.
